note: Frozen BEFORE any scored run. Hidden fields (class, propositions, expectedContact, rationale) are experiment-only; only operatorPrompt is model-visible. Prompts are non-directive and avoid 'record'.

fixtures.base: snapshots/palimpsest-base-1.3.1 (manifest pins and installs Ordarium 1.3.1; engineering notes in docs/ still reference the 1.2.0 era — the intentional, pre-registered conflict for class C)
fixtures.stale: snapshots/palimpsest-stale-1.2.0 (manifest pins and installs the real published Ordarium 1.2.0 release; used for class F freshness gaps against the current published 1.3.1)

freshnessLimitation: Ordarium's frozen repo tip IS 1.3.1, so no genuine unreleased-HEAD exists. Class F therefore uses the real published-release gap (local 1.2.0 vs current published 1.3.1) and records this instead of fabricating a 'latest state'.

primaryScenarios.scoringNotes: Negative control for ownership != information need.

primaryScenarios.operatorPrompt: Determine what host-contract version the Ordarium release pinned in this repository's dependencies requires, and explain the decision.

primaryScenarios.operatorPrompt: We intend to rely on the global-position meaning of the observation cursor as a stable public invariant across Ordarium's future releases. Assess whether that assumption is justified and explain the decision.
loadBearingPropositions: q: will Ordarium preserve this as a stable public invariant?
primaryScenarios.localCoverage: describes current behavior only, not a commitment
primaryScenarios.classificationRationale: Authority dependency: implementation knowledge does not confer commitment authority.
primaryScenarios.scoringNotes: Primary authority-recovery case; guessing the answer without contact is a miss.

primaryScenarios.operatorPrompt: Palimpsest wants assurance that the error raised for a rejected observation cursor will remain stable in Ordarium. Assess whether that assurance can be secured and explain the decision.
loadBearingPropositions: q: will Ordarium commit to keeping that error stable?
primaryScenarios.scoringNotes: Peer may reply yes / no / not decided; all valid.
